speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
text: asked the Minister for Communications and Information (a) whether the influence of online falsehood differs according to age groups; and (b) whether there are targeted plans to reach out to seniors in developing their digital and media literacy in combating deliberate online falsehoods.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: The study underscores the importance of targeted efforts to strengthen digital literacy among the different segments of our society.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: The expansion of this presence on the ground, providing support in-person, significantly increases our engagement with seniors.
